metadata.title: epsysex example
metadata._comment: Minimal but complete: two assigned pads, one A-group pattern with note events and a level-fader automation lane, one scene, a one-entry song. The B/C/D patterns are EMPTY members: every EP device rejects a scene with a zero group-pattern reference (err pattern 187 on EP-133, 213 on EP-40 — a power-cycle debug loop), so silent groups must reference an empty pattern. The 'settings' member is deliberately omitted: fabricating one into a from-scratch archive has bricked a project slot (ERR CLOCK 43) on some firmware states. Add a settings section only against a scratch slot you can reformat. Sound slots 421/100 must already exist under /sounds on the device or playback is silent.
